label: Closed grounding collections rooted, from no wholly borrowed collection (inference)
rule: A ground-closed rootless collection is, by the bridge, closed under every actual supplier, and each member has one; the borrowed-reality principle makes it empty
meaning: The borrowed-reality argument for the closed-collection condition, with its bridge explicit: the principle over all modelled actual suppliers yields the condition only if actual concreta are supplied only by concreta. Without the bridge it fails (Control.abstractSupplier). Constructive; conditional consequence only.
